items.title: FBI attributes $6.3B Binance hack to North Korea
items.feedTitle: FBI says North Korea was behind $6.3 billion Binance heist, the biggest crypto hack in history
items.summary: The FBI says North Korean state-sponsored actors known as TraderTraitor were behind a record $6.3 billion cryptocurrency theft from Binance, the world's largest crypto exchange. The same group was linked to a $1.5 billion Bybit hack last year. Binance says it has located about $3 billion of the stolen assets and is working to recover funds and resume customer withdrawals.

items.title: Judge orders removal of three Trump administration campaign ads
items.feedTitle: Judge orders 3 taxpayer-funded Trump administration ads to be pulled from TV, social media
items.summary: A federal judge ordered the removal of three taxpayer-funded Trump administration advertisements from television and social media, saying they appeared designed for political purposes rather than government information. One ad claimed every American would receive $5,000 if Republicans maintained congressional control. The ruling addresses concerns about misuse of public funds for campaign messaging.

items.title: Analysis finds DOJ voter eligibility list contains errors
items.feedTitle: Analysis: More than 40% of names on DOJ list of alleged noncitizens not on California's voter rolls
items.summary: An outside analysis of the Department of Justice's list of alleged noncitizen voters found that over 40 percent of flagged names do not appear on California's voter rolls, and thousands of U.S. citizens appear incorrectly flagged as ineligible. The DOJ has used this list to threaten prosecution of election officials, but the analysis questions its accuracy and reliability.

items.title: Affordability crisis shapes final midterm push for voters
items.feedTitle: Affordability top of mind for voters in final sprint to midterms: ‘I have to pick between medicine or groceries’
items.summary: With Election Day two days away, affordability has emerged as the dominant concern for millions of Americans heading to the polls, with voters facing difficult choices between medicine, groceries, and other essentials. The cost-of-living crisis has loomed over the entire election cycle as workers and unions champion candidates fighting for higher wages and price relief. Both parties are making final campaign stops emphasizing their respective economic plans.

stlouis.title: St. Louis prepares major Olympic bid with downtown investment
stlouis.feedTitle: Move over, LA: St. Louis gears up for Olympics, invests millions in downtown redevelopment
stlouis.summary: St. Louis is gearing up to pursue hosting the Olympics, investing millions in downtown redevelopment projects to strengthen its candidacy. City officials say the infrastructure improvements will benefit the region regardless of the Olympic outcome. The effort represents a major long-term economic development strategy for the metro area.

stlouis.title: Shooting at north St. Louis County gas station leaves one dead
stlouis.feedTitle: 1 dead, 2 injured in shooting at north St. Louis County gas station
stlouis.summary: One person was killed and two others injured in a shooting at a gas station in north St. Louis County. Police are investigating the incident, which occurred early in the day. Details on motive and suspect status remain limited at this time.

stlouis.title: St. Louis County early voting exceeds 2022 midterm total
stlouis.feedTitle: St. Louis County early voting surpasses total turnout for 2022 midterms
stlouis.summary: Early voting turnout in St. Louis County has already surpassed the total number of votes cast in the 2022 midterm elections, signaling strong voter engagement heading into Election Day. The high early voting numbers reflect national trends of increased midterm participation.

items.title: India opposition rallies against alleged voter roll manipulation
items.feedTitle: Tens of thousands protest against Narendra Modi regime in Delhi
items.summary: Thousands of opposition supporters gathered in Delhi to protest alleged removal of 130 million names from India's voter rolls, which critics say unfairly disadvantages opposition parties ahead of elections. Led by the Congress party, protesters demanded the election commission chief's resignation over concerns about electoral fairness. The rally represents growing momentum in opposition efforts to challenge government policies.

items.title: Iran and US explore diplomacy amid escalating military threats
items.feedTitle: Iran and US explore diplomacy amid rising threats of war
items.summary: Iran and Qatar-led mediators held a third day of talks aimed at de-escalating US-Iran tensions, with Iran proposing it could reopen the Strait of Hormuz within 48 hours if conditions are met. Meanwhile, Trump signaled the US still has military targets to address, keeping the possibility of further strikes alive. Both sides say the outcome depends on the other showing restraint and "rationality."

items.title: Youth-led protests turn violent across Europe after Halloween
items.feedTitle: Attempted murder probe after petrol bomb thrown at French riot police
items.summary: Peaceful youth-led demonstrations against rising costs and poor public services escalated into street violence across France, Germany, Switzerland, Portugal, and Albania over the Halloween weekend. French authorities opened an attempted murder investigation after a petrol bomb was thrown at riot police. Germany's interior minister called for harsh penalties as police deployed tens of thousands across the region.

items.title: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill eight including child
items.feedTitle: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill eight including child, hospitals say
items.summary: Israeli military strikes killed at least eight Palestinians in Gaza, including a child, according to hospital officials. Five Hamas police officers were killed in Khan Younis and three people, including a minor, were killed in Gaza City. The strikes mark the latest escalation in an ongoing conflict with civilian casualties mounting.

items.title: Poland's constitutional court overhaul erupts into physical conflict
items.feedTitle: Poland’s fight over its constitutional court gets physical
items.summary: Poland's prime minister Donald Tusk vowed to proceed with a contested overhaul of the country's constitutional court despite widespread protests, calling the shake-up vital to restore the tribunal crippled by years of political disputes. The dispute has escalated with physical confrontations as the government suspended senior justices and moved to bring criminal charges. The conflict reflects deep divisions within Poland's government.

items.title: Mahadev betting app kingpin extradited from Oman to India
items.feedTitle: Mahadev betting syndicate ‘kingpin’ extradited from Oman
items.summary: The CBI successfully extradited Sourabh Chandrakar, the alleged kingpin of the Rs 6,000-crore Mahadev betting app scam, from Oman following an Interpol Red Corner Notice. Chandrakar is accused of running one of India's largest illegal betting operations. The extradition represents a significant development in a high-profile financial crime investigation.

items.title: New IAF chief outlines VAYU priorities and combat readiness
items.feedTitle: New IAF chief Ashutosh Dixit outlines ‘VAYU’ priorities, vows to boost combat readiness
items.summary: Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit outlined his vision for the Indian Air Force under the "VAYU" initiative, prioritizing indigenous capabilities, joint operations, and restoration of IAF's sanctioned combat strength. The new chief vowed to boost overall combat readiness and emphasized building self-reliance in defense technology. His priorities signal a shift toward modernization and operational effectiveness.

items.title: India's first bullet train design approved by government
items.feedTitle: India’s first Swadeshi bullet train design ready: Ashwini Vaishnaw
items.summary: The Indian government approved the design for India's first indigenous bullet train, marking a major milestone in the country's infrastructure ambitions. The Swadeshi design will enable travel from Delhi to Agra in 59 minutes, Lucknow in 2 hours, and Varanasi in 3.5 hours. The project represents India's commitment to developing world-class rail technology domestically.

items.title: Mahadev betting scandal kingpin arrested following extradition
items.feedTitle: Mahadev betting app kingpin Sourabh Chandrakar extradited from Oman to India
items.summary: Indian authorities completed the extradition of Sourabh Chandrakar from Oman, bringing him to face charges in the massive Mahadev online betting app scandal worth Rs 6,000 crore. The operation involved sophisticated illegal betting networks and financial fraud. His arrest marks progress in dismantling one of India's largest organized crime betting syndicates.

immigration.title: Trump administration finalizes H-1B extension restrictions
immigration.feedTitle: Trump Administration Moves to End H-1B Extension Protections, Finalizes Restrictions on Work Permit Renewals
immigration.summary: The Trump administration finalized restrictions ending automatic H-1B work visa extensions, significantly tightening the renewal process for foreign workers. The regulation, which takes effect immediately, removes "deference to prior approvals" and could make renewals harder for existing visa holders. The move is part of broader administration efforts to restrict employment-based immigration.

immigration.title: Appeals court keeps diversity visa lottery suspended
immigration.feedTitle: US Diversity Visa lottery remains suspended as appeals court blocks reopening | Hindustan Times
immigration.summary: A federal appeals court blocked the reopening of the FY 2027 Diversity Visa lottery program, keeping the program suspended indefinitely while litigation continues. The court's decision means the green card lottery remains closed, affecting millions of prospective applicants worldwide who rely on this immigration pathway. The ruling represents a major setback for those seeking alternative routes to US immigration.

immigration.title: November visa bulletin shows family-sponsored advances for India
immigration.feedTitle: US Visa Bulletin November 2026: EB-2 unchanged, EB-3 Green Card dates advance for India
immigration.summary: The November 2026 visa bulletin shows significant advancement in family-sponsored green card categories for Indian applicants, with movement advancing by one full year. Employment-based EB-2 and EB-3 categories for India remain unchanged, reflecting the massive backlog facing skilled Indian workers. The modest progress in family categories offers limited relief in an otherwise stalled system.

items.title: Binance resumes crypto withdrawals after $6.3B North Korea hack
items.feedTitle: Binance to Resume Customer Withdrawals in Phases After Hack
items.summary: Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, began phased resumption of customer withdrawals after the record $6.3 billion hack attributed to North Korea's TraderTraitor group. The exchange says it has located approximately $3 billion of stolen assets and is covering 90 percent of customer losses. The incident has raised major questions about cryptocurrency security and the viability of centralized exchanges.

items.feedTitle: OPEC+ keeps December oil output targets steady ahead of tougher call for 2027
items.summary: OPEC and allied producers kept December oil output targets unchanged at their latest meeting, despite ongoing threats to Gulf shipping from regional conflicts. The decision to hold steady comes as geopolitical tensions continue to roil energy markets. Analysts warn that a potential escalation in Middle East hostilities could force the cartel to reassess production in coming weeks.

items.title: AI stock selloff wipes $5 trillion amid investor caution
items.feedTitle: AI stocks just lost $5 trillion — but history says the stock market's sweetest stretch starts now
items.summary: A major correction in artificial intelligence stocks has erased approximately $5 trillion in market value as investors grow skeptical that billions in AI spending can generate near-term returns. The selloff reflects questions about valuations of AI companies with substantial debt and negative cash flow. History suggests market rallies often follow correction phases, offering potential opportunities for patient investors.

cards.title: Control What You Can
cards.insight: Stoics teach that external outcomes—election results, market moves, geopolitical events—lie outside your control. What remains in your power is your response: your focus, effort, and values.
cards.takeaway: Before the midterms, focus on understanding the issues that matter to you and voting accordingly; release anxiety about outcomes you cannot influence.

cards.title: Distinguish Fact from Fear
cards.insight: The mind amplifies uncertain threats—rising prices, AI hacks, visa delays—into catastrophes. Stoics advocate separating what is actually happening from the stories we tell about it.
cards.takeaway: When facing immigration uncertainty or market volatility, write down only what you know for certain; discard assumptions about worst-case futures.

cards.title: Use Setbacks as Teachers
cards.insight: A tech selloff, policy restriction, or extradition is not a disaster but an opportunity to test your resilience and discover what truly matters to you.
cards.takeaway: If your visa path closes or your portfolio drops, ask: what does this teach me about my priorities? How can I adapt without losing my principles?

cards.title: Practice Indifference to Fortune
cards.insight: Stoics advocated *apatheia*—not numbness, but freedom from the grip of desire and fear. Wealth, status, and comfort are "preferred indifferents"—nice to have but not worth compromising integrity.
cards.takeaway: When tempted by a shortcut (cutting corners at work to afford higher costs, or chasing volatile crypto returns), pause and ask: is this consistent with who I want to be?

ai.title: OpenAI raises less than half of $30B funding target
ai.feedTitle: OpenAI Raises Less Than Half of $30 Billion Target in Latest Round
ai.summary: OpenAI's latest funding round fell significantly short of expectations, raising less than half of its $30 billion target. The shortfall reflects investor hesitation about the company's path to profitability and concerns over mounting capex spending without clear revenue models. The funding miss comes as rival Anthropic prepares for a major IPO at a potentially much higher valuation.

ai.title: DeepSeek launches autonomous coding agent challenging Claude
ai.feedTitle: DeepSeek unveils AI ‘super agent’ in coding race with OpenAI, Anthropic
ai.summary: DeepSeek unveiled an autonomous coding AI agent weeks ahead of Anthropic's expected IPO, positioning it directly against Anthropic's Claude Code offering. The move intensifies competition in the AI coding space as multiple companies race to develop agents that can write software autonomously. DeepSeek's launch signals accelerating competition in AI model capabilities.

ai.title: Anthropic's Claude blocks video game cloning with broad restrictions
ai.feedTitle: Anthropic's Claude AI blocks video game cloning and reverse-engineering — sweeping new restrictions also hit legitimate developers and basic troubleshooting tasks
ai.summary: Anthropic ordered its Claude AI model to stop helping with video game cloning and reverse-engineering, implementing sweeping restrictions that also affect legitimate developers and basic troubleshooting tasks. The policy shift raises concerns about overly broad content restrictions that could limit legitimate software development use cases. The move reflects tension between preventing misuse and enabling beneficial applications.

ai.title: Google's space satellite TPU writes poetry using Gemini 4
ai.feedTitle: Google’s first data center satellite is online and writing poetry
ai.summary: Google's first data center satellite is now online and successfully running a Gemini 4 model, with the TPU in space generating poetry and demonstrating the viability of orbital AI computing. The breakthrough represents a significant step toward Google's ambition to build distributed data centers leveraging satellite networks. The achievement shows progress in scaling AI infrastructure beyond traditional earthbound constraints.
